text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around the academy when I
hear
someone talking.
Siiigh... My heart's pounding... I wonder if they'll confess their love to each other after this part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow the voice and find Mejiro Ryan
hiding out
of sight, secretly reading a
manga.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, this artist's stuff is the best... All
right! I'm
gonna get the whole series and
binge-read 'em
all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what the?! H-how long have you
been
standing there?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-it's a romance manga but, uhhh... Oh,
yeah! A
friend of mine suggested I check
out this series,
and I didn't wanna be
rude and not read it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I came across an old series
by my
favorite artist and decided to buy
it or anything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I don't usually read
romance
manga! I mean, a gym rat like
me liking romance
manga? Pfft, no way,
right? Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I was thinking of
bingeing the
whole series is so I can tell
my friend what I think
about it ASAP...
Honest!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If I don't get enough sleep,
then I
won't be able to train to my full
potential...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna read it, but I guess I'll hold off...
Huh,
that's kinda like holding off on
making a move
during a race to save
energy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll read at a reasonable pace! But
don't
forget—I'm only reading it because
my friend
recommended it to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's reading or racing, pacing
yourself is
extremely important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aww, but I really wanna read it all—er, I
mean... I
really wanna tell my friend what
I think about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll adjust my schedule so that I
can rest up
after my binge-reading
session!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It sucks to have to do this, but things
should work
out if I move my morning
weight training to
another time slot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I still think not binge-reading the series would be the most sensible option, but at least she's finding time for a proper rest.
